description: Daily OHLCV and open interest for 139 futures markets (CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX, ICE, Eurex, Cboe): every individual contract since 2007 plus continuous back-adjusted series. Give root (ES, NQ, YM, RTY, CL, GC, SI, NG, ZN, ZB, VX, 6E ...; a leading '/' is fine) for the continuous series, or contract (e.g. ESZ26) for one contract. Clipped to as_of. Free keys get recent days; full history from $49 per market.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

continuous.description: Back-adjusted continuous series (default true when no contract).

root.description: Futures root, e.g. ES, NQ, CL, GC, VX.

name: get_futures
title: Get futures bars
